2,931 likes, 75 comments - beautypost.in on August 11, 2026: "From waiting for you two, without knowing who you would be…
to finally knowing you, holding you, and calling you by your names. 🤍

Once, this bassinet held nothing but our dreams of you. 

Then came the waiting.
The wondering.
The imagining of two little faces we hadn’t yet met.

And then, suddenly, you were here.

Two little boys in our arms.
Two little souls who made us parents.
Two names that somehow already feel like they have belonged to you forever.

🔱 Rudra
Strength that protects — a symbol of courage, power and the quiet strength to stand for those you love. The one who drives away evil & eradicates problems from their roots.

🫯Vaayu
The breath that gives life — a symbol of vitality, freedom and the spirit to move fearlessly through life. The one who is free spirited, inquisitive & full of life.

Two names chosen with all the love, hopes and prayers we hold for you.

Our Rudra & Vaayu, two brothers who will have each other through every chapter that lies ahead 🧿🧿

Our greatest blessing, our most beautiful beginning.

#twinmomlife #twinnursery #twinmom #twinboys".

On 17th June 2026, that secret became the greatest blessing of our lives 🧿

🩵🩵 Our precious twin boys, our rainbow babies 🌈 welcomed us into parenthood.

Our hearts have been overflowing ever since—trying to take in a love so immense, a blessing so unexpected, and a joy that’s impossible to put into words. 🥹🤍

We’re endlessly grateful for every prayer, every kind thought, and every blessing that surrounded us through this journey. 🙏🏻✨

Our greatest chapter with the sweetest love story has just begun. 🤍♾️".
